purpose: Read-only inventory for the Prism SN_SEPOLIA/Base Sepolia rehearsal. This is a source-and-spec inventory, not a deployment manifest and not an evidence envelope.

inspection_basis.source_scope: exact backend candidate implementation commit; tracked source routes only

target.mainnet_policy: SN_MAIN and Base Mainnet are release-gated and rejected by the dry-run harness

maturity_contract.specified: Canonical/system documents or a named readiness requirement define the surface.
maturity_contract.implemented: The local source route/domain boundary exists; this is not transport or network evidence.
maturity_contract.integrated: The route is wired to the local application boundary, or the packet records why it is not yet wired. This is code integration only.
maturity_contract.deployed: A matching runtime/contract artifact exists on the target network and is read back.
maturity_contract.observed: A direct provider response, receipt, event, HTTP trace, or projection read was captured.
maturity_contract.repeated: The observation was repeated with restart/replay/independent read as required by the gate.
maturity_contract.promotable: The complete evidence packet passes its validator and is eligible for the declared maturity; no rehearsal row is promotable by itself.

rules: Use Idempotency-Key for create/bind/revoke/intent requests and reuse it only for an identical fingerprint.
Use If-Match as the expected operation/pause version where the route supports CAS.
An app session authenticates the product request; it never substitutes for a Starknet controller or Base proof.
A response operation.state is authoritative for workflow UX; HTTP 200 does not mean completed.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session plus user-controlled Starknet wallet
endpoints.authority: Starknet registry; backend only creates the durable operation and relays an authorized request
endpoints.side_effect: allocates persistent identity on Starknet; no token movement

request.body_secret_policy: no private key, seed, password, viewing key, or keyed URL

endpoints.integration_note: Local handler and application boundary are present; a live next-start transport trace and real submit adapter are not established by this packet.

endpoints.audience: public read
endpoints.authority: canonical Starknet registry read, or a bounded projection that preserves canonical authority
endpoints.side_effect: read only

response.success_shape: {ok:true,data:{prismId,controller,exists,watermark?},watermark?}; controller is null when the identity is absent only if the application chooses an explicit empty response

endpoints.evidence_note: Record identity/event agreement and the read watermark; do not treat an operation row as identity truth.

endpoints.audience: public discovery read; privacy review required before exposure
endpoints.authority: registryReadPort in local/dev path, scoped public event projection in the fallback path; never frontend cache
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.integration_note: Route is tracked in the integrated backend snapshot and covered by focused route tests. Canonical/projection readback, UNKNOWN status, and distinct NONE/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE semantics remain explicit; OpenAPI is unchanged in this backend-only integration.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session; proof is for the named Base execution account
endpoints.authority: server challenge store and server policy for domain, chain ID, TTL, and nonce
endpoints.side_effect: stores an ISSUED challenge and single-use nonce; no chain write
endpoints.evidence_note: Challenge values are not secrets, but signatures and session linkage remain operationally sensitive; record only the fields needed to correlate the proof.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session plus user-controlled Base signer
endpoints.authority: backend verification ladder for proof validity only; no canonical binding until the Starknet transition
endpoints.side_effect: consumes the challenge nonce on verification attempt; no Starknet write
endpoints.evidence_note: VERIFIED is not ACTIVE and does not prove a binding. Altered fields fail before verification; an attempted verification consumes the nonce according to the service contract.

endpoints.audience: public audience only
endpoints.authority: public binding disclosure store backed by canonical binding state
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.privacy_note: PRIVATE and SELECTIVE rows must never be collapsed into this response. Base bindings are public linkage by v0 design.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session, verified Base proof, and user-controlled Starknet controller
endpoints.authority: Starknet registry caller/controller check and onchain digest single-use; backend is a trusted proof verifier only
endpoints.side_effect: creates an ACTIVE public binding only at a successful Starknet state transition; no asset movement
endpoints.evidence_note: The route may return a submitted operation before a receipt. Canonical ACTIVE requires receipt, matching event, reconciliation, and an independent read.

endpoints.audience: owner-authorized private audience only
endpoints.authority: owner authorization port plus private-binding protection port; session alone is insufficient
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.privacy_note: Current protection is intentionally fail-closed until encryption-at-rest, key ownership, recovery, and owner authorization providers are proven. No plaintext endpoint belongs in logs, public responses, or evidence.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session plus identity controller
endpoints.authority: Starknet registry controller authorization; parent Prism identity survives
endpoints.side_effect: marks the binding REVOKED at a successful Starknet transition; no asset movement

response.success_shape: {ok:true,data:{operationId,state},operation:{operationId,state,version},requestId}; repeated revoke may report the already-revoked fact

endpoints.evidence_note: After a successful revoke, resolve must return NO_ACTIVE_DESTINATION and the parent identity must still read.

endpoints.audience: public read
endpoints.authority: canonical Starknet state or bounded projection; cache past the watermark is never authoritative
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.evidence_note: A stale ACTIVE cache must be refused or replaced by canonical NO_ACTIVE_DESTINATION. Record watermark and confirmed block together.

endpoints.audience: public read; provider and explicit association evidence remain visible as typed state
endpoints.authority: external alias provider evidence plus explicit Prism-owned association; alias text never becomes a Prism ID by inference
endpoints.side_effect: read only

request.note: Provider and value are decoded and normalized at the route boundary; no session or body is required.

endpoints.blocker: Do not add an HTTP claim or simulate provider success until the provider interface, association authority, and transport schema are accepted.
endpoints.integration_note: Provider success, not-found, unavailable, invalid, and interface-blocked outcomes remain typed in data; Prism ID is populated only from explicit association evidence. No OpenAPI file was changed.

endpoints.audience: public read; external provider/association evidence and snapshot freshness remain explicit
endpoints.authority: canonical resolution plus durable, scoped snapshot store; Pause consumes typed risk codes, not an opaque score
endpoints.side_effect: read plus durable snapshot comparison when the configured snapshot store is available

request.note: venue defaults to BASE and purpose defaults to default; prism: identifiers are accepted directly, while aliases use provider:value or an explicit provider query.

endpoints.blocker: No continuity/Pause integration claim is allowed until alias association, snapshot durability, and risk delivery are transport-tested.
endpoints.integration_note: FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN and resolved/no-destination/unavailable states remain distinct; snapshots are public allow-list projections and risks never directly authorize Pause.

endpoints.audience: authenticated app session plus wallet-mediated provider boundary
endpoints.authority: user-controlled STRK20-capable wallet/prover/provider; Prism owns intent, policy, lifecycle, and labels, not viewing keys or private notes
endpoints.side_effect: would request a wallet action; never execute from this harness

request.note: kind is shield, private_transfer, or application; operation is create, prepare, submit, or observe_receipt. Forbidden proof/calldata/raw/provider/key/note fields are rejected before the handler.

response.success_shape: {ok:true,data:JSON-safe Strk20ActionData,requestId}; submitted and receipt-confirmed remain distinct lifecycle states

endpoints.blocker: Requires Wallet API/spec capability >=0.10.3, correct SN_SEPOLIA network, explicit consent, real proof, receipt, pool event, and independent read.
endpoints.integration_note: Create is process-local and idempotency-fenced; prepare/submit/observe_receipt are explicit lifecycle operations behind injected wallet/provider ports. No provider response, proof, calldata, viewing key, or private note is projected.

endpoints.audience: public JSON-safe lifecycle read in this slice; provider/raw material remains excluded
endpoints.authority: durable operation plus provider receipt/reconciliation; submitted hash alone is not completion
endpoints.side_effect: read only when implemented

response.success_shape: {ok:true,data:JSON-safe Strk20ActionData,requestId}; proof.call is always null at transport

endpoints.blocker: No action readback may be represented by the generic operations route until the privacy-specific schema exists.

endpoints.audience: explicitly scoped privacy receipt projection; no viewing-key, note, sender-attribution, or raw provider material
endpoints.authority: provider receipt plus typed privacy attribution; shield metadata and private-transfer metadata remain distinct
endpoints.side_effect: read only when implemented
endpoints.blocker: The existing /v1/receipts route is generic operation-derived state and is not a privacy receipt.
endpoints.integration_note: OBSERVED requires a matching successful final receipt and pinned pool event; receipt projection is derived from the action lifecycle and does not create a second ledger.

endpoints.authority: durable operation store for workflow status; chain RPC for submitted/processing/confirming/confirmed facts; indexer/reconciliation for completion
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.evidence_note: Poll this resource after every chain-touching request. Do not skip from submitted to completed; unknown remains poll-only or requires_attention.

endpoints.audience: operation participant or policy-approved reader
endpoints.authority: operation-derived projection; not a substitute for a chain receipt or independent read
endpoints.side_effect: read only
endpoints.evidence_note: The generic receipt is only complete after reconciliation; a submitted or processing row is not a confirmed receipt.
